title: Using the Torchinfo Package to Get a Summary of Our Model

cues.en: In the last video.
cues.zh: 上支影片，

cues.en: We checked our model by doing a forward pass on a single batch, and we learned that our forward method
cues.zh: 我們用單一批次做前向傳遞，檢查模型，知道目前的 forward 方法

cues.en: so far looks like it's intact and that we don't get any shape errors as our data moves through the model.
cues.zh: 看起來完整，資料通過模型時不會發生形狀錯誤。

cues.en: But I'd like to introduce to you one of my favorite packages for finding out information from a two inch model, and that is torch info.
cues.zh: 不過，我想介紹一個很喜歡的套件，用來取得 PyTorch 模型資訊，就是 torchinfo。

cues.en: So let's use torch info to get an idea of the shapes going through our model.
cues.zh: 用 torchinfo 了解通過模型的資料形狀。

cues.en: So you know how much I love doing things in a programmatic way.
cues.zh: 你知道我很喜歡用程式完成事情。

cues.en: Well, that's what torch info does.
cues.zh: torchinfo 做的正是這件事。

cues.en: Before we used print statements to find out the different shapes going through our model, and I'm just going to comment these out in our forward method so that when we run this later on during training,
cues.zh: 之前用 print 陳述式，找出通過模型的不同形狀；我先把 forward 裡這些 print 註解掉，這樣稍後訓練時，

cues.en: we don't get excessive printouts of all the shapes.
cues.zh: 不會印出過多形狀資訊。

cues.en: So let's see what torch info does.
cues.zh: 看看 torchinfo 的功能。

cues.en: And in the last video I issued a challenge to give it a go.
cues.zh: 上支影片給你的挑戰，就是試著用它。

cues.en: It's quite straightforward of how to use it, but let's see it together.
cues.zh: 使用方法相當直接，不過一起看看。

cues.en: This is the type of output we're looking for from our tiny VG model.
cues.zh: 希望從 TinyVGG 模型取得這種輸出。

cues.en: And of course you could get this type of output from almost any PyTorch model.
cues.zh: 當然，幾乎任何 PyTorch 模型都能取得這種輸出。

cues.en: But we have to install it first.
cues.zh: 但必須先安裝。

cues.en: And as far as I know, Google collab doesn't come with torch info by default.
cues.zh: 據我所知，Google Colab 預設沒有 torchinfo。

cues.en: Now you might as well try this in the future and see if it works.
cues.zh: 之後可以再試試，看是否能直接使用。

cues.en: But yeah, I don't get this module because my Google colab instance, does it have an installed?
cues.zh: 不過，對，我找不到這個模組，因為 Colab 執行個體沒有安裝。

cues.en: No problem with that.
cues.zh: 沒問題。

cues.en: Let's install torch info here, install torch info and then we'll import it if it's available.
cues.zh: 在這裡安裝 torchinfo，可用的話就匯入。

cues.en: So we're going to try and import torch info.
cues.zh: 所以先 try，匯入 torchinfo。

cues.en: If it's already installed, we'll import it.
cues.zh: 如果已安裝，就會匯入。

cues.en: And then if it doesn't work, if that tri block fails, we're going to run PIP, install torch info and then we will import torch info.
cues.zh: 如果不成功，try 區塊失敗，就執行 pip install torchinfo，然後再匯入 torchinfo。

cues.en: And then we're going to run down here from torch info, import summary.
cues.zh: 接著在這裡 from torchinfo import summary。

cues.en: And then if this all works, we're going to get a summary of our model.
cues.zh: 如果都成功，就能取得模型摘要。

cues.en: We're going to pass it in module zero and we have to put in an input size here.
cues.zh: 傳入 model_0，還要設定 input_size。

cues.en: Now that is an example of the size of the data that will flow through our model.
cues.zh: 它是會通過模型的資料大小範例。

cues.en: So in our case, let's put in an input size of one three 6464.
cues.zh: 這裡設定 input_size 為 (1, 3, 64, 64)。

cues.en: So this is an example of putting in a batch of one image you could potentially put in 32 here if you wanted, but let's just put in a batch of a singular image and of course, we could change these values
cues.zh: 代表送入一批只有一張的影像；想要也能在這裡填 32，但先用單張影像的批次。當然，也能更改這裡的

cues.en: here if we wanted to, to do four 2 to 4.
But what you might notice is that if it doesn't get the right input size, it produces an error.
cues.zh: 不過你會注意到，如果輸入大小不對，就會產生錯誤。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 有了。

cues.en: So just like we got before, when we printed out our input sizes manually, we get an error here because what torch info behind the scenes is going to do is it's going to do a forward pass on whichever model
cues.zh: 就像之前手動印出輸入大小時，這裡也會出錯，因為 torchinfo 在背後會對你

cues.en: you pass it with an input size of whichever input size you give it.
cues.zh: 傳入的模型，以給定的 input_size 做一次前向傳遞。

cues.en: So let's put in the input size that our model was built for.
cues.zh: 所以改用模型建立時所對應的輸入大小。

cues.en: Wonderful.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So what torch info gives us is, Oh, excuse me.
cues.zh: torchinfo 提供的內容，哦，不好意思。

cues.en: We didn't comment out the printouts before, so just make sure we've commented out these printouts in the forward method of our 20 VG class.
cues.zh: 剛才沒有把 print 註解掉，所以要確認 TinyVGG 類別的 forward 方法，已經把這些 print 註解。

cues.en: So I'm just going to run this.
cues.zh: 我先執行這個。

cues.en: Then we run that, run that just to make sure everything still works.
cues.zh: 再執行這個、這個，確認一切仍然正常。

cues.en: We'll run torch info.
cues.zh: 執行 torchinfo。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 有了。

cues.en: So no printouts from our model, but this is Look how beautiful this is.
cues.zh: 模型不再額外印資訊，不過看看這個多漂亮。

cues.en: I love how this prints out.
cues.zh: 我很喜歡這種列印格式。

cues.en: So we have our tiny VG class and then we can see it's comprised of three sequential blocks.
cues.zh: 有 TinyVGG 類別，也看得出它由三個 Sequential 區塊組成。

cues.en: And then inside those sequential blocks, we have different combinations of layers.
cues.zh: 各 Sequential 區塊裡，有不同的層組合。

cues.en: We have some layers, some railway layers, some max pool layers.
cues.zh: 有卷積層、ReLU 層、最大池化層。

cues.en: And then the final layer is our classification layer with a flatten and a linear layer.
cues.zh: 最後是分類層，包含 Flatten 與 Linear。

cues.en: And we can see the shapes changing throughout our model as our data goes in and gets manipulated by the various layers.
cues.zh: 能看到資料進入模型，經過各層處理，形狀一路改變。

cues.en: So are these in line with the CNN explainer?
cues.zh: 和 CNN Explainer 一致嗎？

cues.en: So if we check this last one, we've already verified this before and we also get some other helpful information down here, which is total params.
cues.zh: 檢查最後一個，之前已經驗證過；下面也有其他有用的資訊，就是總參數數量。

cues.en: So you can see that each of these layers has a different amount of parameters to learn.
cues.zh: 可看到每一層要學習的參數數量不同。

cues.en: Now recall that a parameter is a value such as a white or a biased term within each of our layers, which starts off as a random number.
cues.zh: 記得，參數是各層裡像權重或偏差這樣的值，一開始是隨機數。

cues.en: And the whole goal of deep learning is to adjust those random numbers to better represent our data.
cues.zh: 深度學習的整體目標，就是調整這些隨機數，更好地表示資料。

cues.en: So in our case, we have just over 8000 total parameters.
cues.zh: 這裡總參數數量略多於 8,000。

cues.en: Now this is actually quite small.
cues.zh: 其實相當小。

cues.en: In the future, you'll probably play around with models that have a million parameters or more, and models now are starting to have many billions of parameters.
cues.zh: 未來你可能會用到一百萬個參數以上的模型，而現在模型開始有數十億個參數。

cues.en: And we also get some information here, such as how much the model size would be.
cues.zh: 這裡也提供資訊，例如模型大小。

cues.en: Now, this would be very helpful depending on where we had to put our model.
cues.zh: 依照模型必須放在哪裡，這可能非常有幫助。

cues.en: So what you'll notice is that as a model gets larger, as more layers, it will have more parameters, more whites and biased terms that can be adjusted to learn patterns and data.
cues.zh: 你會注意到，模型越大、層越多，就會有更多參數，更多能調整的權重與偏差，學習資料中的模式。

cues.en: But its input size and its estimated total size would definitely get bigger as well.
cues.zh: 不過，input_size 與估計總大小也一定會變大。

cues.en: So that's just something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 所以這一點要記住，

cues.en: If you have size constraints in terms of storage on in your future applications.
cues.zh: 如果未來應用程式有儲存空間大小限制。

cues.en: So ours is under a megabyte which is quite small, but you might find that some models in the future get up to 500 megabytes, maybe even over a gigabyte.
cues.zh: 我們的模型不到 1 MB，相當小，但你可能遇到 500 MB，甚至超過 1 GB 的模型。

cues.en: So just keep that in mind for going forward.
cues.zh: 所以接下來記得這一點。

cues.en: And that's the crux of today's info.
cues.zh: 這就是 torchinfo 的重點。

cues.en: One of my favorite packages just gives you an idea of the input and output shapes of each of your layers, so you can use touch info wherever you need.
cues.zh: 是我最喜歡的套件之一，能了解每層的輸入輸出形狀，需要時就能使用 torchinfo。

cues.en: It should work with most of your high touch models.
cues.zh: 應該適用於大多數 PyTorch 模型。

cues.en: Just be sure to pass it in the right input size.
cues.zh: 只要確認傳入正確 input_size。

cues.en: You can also use it to verify like we did before if the input and output shapes are correct.
cues.zh: 也能像剛才一樣，用它驗證輸入輸出形狀是否正確。

cues.en: So check that out.
cues.zh: 去看看吧。
